review.images: Reviewed the exact official hero and six gallery images. The hero and pool gallery show the same pool from closely related viewpoints. Used the wide hero and kept the distinct terrace, lobby, bedroom, playroom and living scenes.
review.location: Matched the named developer point. Visually verified the original map on brochure page 6 and all four driving estimates on page 4.
review.floorPlans: Reviewed all 20 original physical pages. Kept 17 complete sheets, two townhouse and fifteen apartment layouts. The broker-hosted booklet specifically names Golf Hills 2 on its cover and each drawing. Checked imperial columns separately. Page 19 prints 1738.59 sq ft versus 1738.64 in components. Page 12 first group’s printed metric components also differ from its metric total, while the imperial figures reconcile. Kept the source figures.

unavailable: The exact project booklet is an Emaar-branded broker-hosted copy. A developer-hosted copy with verified Golf Hills 2 ownership was not found.
Current signed unit areas and entrance-level directions were not verified.
